title: Console responsive overhaul: dashboard, rollouts, cost pages — cross-browser polish and prototype review
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Rework layout and visual polish for three console surfaces (Dashboards, Rollouts, Cost Breakdown) to ensure consistent responsive behavior across desktop and mobile breakpoints and to resolve cross-browser rendering issues discovered during initial QA. Deliverables: updated responsive rules (desktop/tablet/phone), interactive Figma prototypes for each page state (empty/filled/error/overflow), accessibility notes (focus management, keyboard flow, aria labels), and a cross-browser QA checklist. Work will include coordinating with ENG for virtualized table rows, chart reflow hooks, and modal stacking behaviors.
acceptance_criteria: All three pages have deterministic layouts at 4 breakpoints (>=1400px, 1024-1399px, 768-1023px, <=767px)
Data tables preserve column visibility options without horizontal scroll at tablet width; when overflow is unavoidable, a sticky column + horizontal scroll pattern is implemented
Charts reflow without pixel artifacts on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge; legend and axis labels wrap gracefully on narrow widths
Modals maintain focus trap, background scroll lock, and correct stacking on multi-modal flows across browsers (including iOS Safari)
No visual regressions in Console theme (light/dark); high-contrast text meets WCAG AA for primary content
Prototype validated by PM and ENG with at least one round of implementation feedback and a successful QA pass on staging
tasks: DES: Create Figma prototype for Dashboard responsive states (desktop/tablet/phone)
DES: Create Figma prototype for Rollouts page including canary/A-B variant tables and rollout detail modal
DES: Create Figma prototype for Cost Breakdown with stacked/expanded chart states and mobile accordion
ENG: Implement responsive CSS grid rules and utility breakpoints (coordinate with DES on naming)
ENG: Add chart resize observer hook and debounce to prevent re-render jitter in Safari
ENG: Virtualize table rows to keep scroll performance for large rollout lists
QA: Run cross-browser checklist across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge on macOS and Windows and iOS Safari
DES/PM: Review implementation, capture visual diffs, and sign off on staging
